name: WideWorldImporters.FinOps.LandingZone
description: Wide World Importers (fictional) runs multi-subscription Azure landing zones with shared hub networking, workload spokes, and a FinOps review ask: tag governance, budget alerts, reserved instance posture, and Azure Policy sets for encryption and public network restrictions.
compliance_posture: Financial controls vocabulary — cost allocation and management attestation at **architecture** level only
Azure Policy initiatives discussed as design intent, not as live tenant scan results
constraints: Deny public IPs on sensitive PaaS via policy at landing zone scope (design intent)
Mandatory resource tags: cost-center, environment, workload-owner before production promotion
Hub egress through firewall; spoke-to-spoke via hub (illustrative)
assumptions: Single Entra ID tenant; management group hierarchy already exists for pilot story
No third-party FinOps tool in scope — Azure-native exports only in this starter
inline_requirements: Review should highlight **observability** for cost anomalies and **governance** drift (tags, location) without asserting measured savings
